july_gap.decision: A real pending function implementation; do not mark it applied as a metadata-only reconciliation. Its application requires a separately authorized production change.

june_equivalence.evidence: Both stored remote migration statements exactly match the source statements after removing their final semicolons; the live function body also matches.

benchmark_receipts.setup_scope: Temporary auth_bench_68 schema/table and public.auth_bench_68_verify(text); 1000 unique bench-* subjects and 64-hex test key hashes. No business KB tables, raw bearer tokens, or network URLs observed in the stored statements.
benchmark_receipts.cleanup_scope: Drops the temporary function/table/schema; transaction-local timeouts and schema-cache notification only.
benchmark_receipts.proposed_public_representation: Explicit historical baseline receipt files at the observed versions, with provenance and original statement hashes, and SELECT 1 as no-op content. These are receipts, not byte-identical imports of the temporary benchmark SQL.
benchmark_receipts.net_effect: Skipping setup and cleanup on a fresh replay yields the same final catalog for these temporary benchmark objects. Preserve both original production ledger entries and their stored SQL unchanged.

minimal_plan: Keep production automatic deployment disabled during adoption.
Import the exact May 28 hotfix source and provenance; add explicitly documented no-op receipts for the two already-cleaned benchmark versions.
Qualify the resulting source chain on a disposable local database; do not execute the benchmark fixtures again.
Immediately before any separately authorized remote metadata update, rerun every SELECT below and require the expected ledgers, 66 function fingerprints, hotfix catalog facts, and benchmark absence.

Map only the 34 legacy filenames (33 imported plus hotfix) into the Supabase history through a separately authorized metadata-only operation. Preserve the existing June and two benchmark entries; do not alter public.kb_schema_migrations or mark July applied.

After that metadata step, local history contains 38 versions and remote contains 37; July is the sole genuine pending migration. Resolve it through separately authorized production application and validation before enabling automatic production deployment.
limitations: This is not a full production schema export or full table/RLS/ACL comparison.
Legacy ledger rows do not contain source checksums, so historical byte execution cannot be proved by filenames alone.
The July optimization has not been tested against production rows or executed; matching behavior to the current function is not asserted.
Supabase dashboard integration configuration is outside these SQL observations.
